name: Vortex Ring
desc: A ring cannon fired down a hazy tunnel, sliced through its axis: each smoke ring is a counter-rotating vortex pair that rolls its dye slug into a double spiral, and because every ring swims in the field of the one ahead they leapfrog — the trailing ring contracts, accelerates, shoots clean through the leader's throat and widens as the pair trade places, over and over; as a backlit wind-tunnel smoke study, a signed-vorticity PIV plate, sumi ink puffs, luminous spectral flux, or a cross-hatched engraving.

energy.doc: circulation — ring speed, how tightly the dye rolls up, and the glow (the master knob)

scale.doc: ring size — from small fast darts to fat rings that nearly span the frame

speed.doc: time rate for the whole tunnel (0.2 still swims)

density.doc: how many rings are in flight — the firing rate of the nozzle

core.doc: vortex core radius — tight hard cores that spin fiercely through to fat diffuse ones that barely bite

hue.doc: hue of the dye (the tunnel haze takes the complement)

x.doc: nozzle position along the tunnel — rings always swim toward +x

style.doc: aesthetic: backlit wind-tunnel smoke study / abstracted signed-vorticity PIV plate / sumi ink puffs on paper / luminous spectral flux / cross-hatched fluid-mechanics engraving

seed.doc: deterministic seed for the firing jitter, ring size scatter and haze stratification
